evals.prompt: This project already uses Agent Guidance Kit. Add Agent Runtime Router from the explicit checkout, but first show separate Guidance Kit and ARR plans and do not modify anything.
evals.expected_output: The response reads both projects' canonical skills, inventories the target and active harness, resolves the explicit ARR checkout, produces separate read-only plans, preserves target-owned routing policy, and waits for approval.
assertions: Keeps Agent Guidance Kit as the guidance owner and ARR as the routing owner
Uses install_runtime.py plan and integration-plan without mutation
Requires separate approvals and does not inspect credentials

evals.prompt: Refresh the Agent Guidance Kit skills in this repository from its resolved checkout.
evals.expected_output: The response routes to agent-guidance-maintenance and does not invoke the runtime-router bridge unless ARR adoption is also requested.
assertions: Does not create or update ARR adapter files
Preserves the existing Guidance Kit receipt workflow

evals.prompt: Set up subagent routing in this project; it already has Agent Guidance Kit, but I have not said which router or harness behavior I want.
evals.expected_output: The response asks for or inventories the explicit ARR source and active harness, checks for an existing router owner, and stops at a read-only plan until the router and approval scope are clear.
assertions: Does not guess a provider, model, harness, or ARR checkout
Does not overwrite an existing router or run a provider probe
